name: improvement-planner
description: Ask-first, plan-only drafts of phased or full-shot AI-readiness improvements. Does not implement.

inputs.name: planning-consent
inputs.description: True only when the user consented to improvement planning.

inputs.name: plan-mode
inputs.description: Plan shape; must be phased or full-shot.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: improvement-plan
outputs.description: Markdown improvement plan; empty when consent is missing.

outputs.name: blocking-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list of blocking questions; empty when none.
